title: 💪 The protein ceiling is debunked
hook: 💪 The protein ceiling is debunked
caption:
💪 The protein ceiling is debunked

For decades, you heard your body could only use a small amount of protein at once.

Research just blew that up.

A 100 gram dose of protein after a workout sparks muscle building that lasts way past when most people assumed it stopped.

The anabolic window isn't a quick moment. It's a wide door that stays open for half a day.

🔬 What the data actually shows

A typical 25 gram serving gives you the familiar spike in muscle protein synthesis.

A 100 gram serving gives you:

* A higher overall rate of muscle tissue repair
* An anabolic response elevated for 12+

title: BUSY MEN: YOUR PHYSIQUE IS BUILT BY WHAT YOU REPEAT. 💪
hook: BUSY MEN: YOUR PHYSIQUE IS BUILT BY WHAT YOU REPEAT. 💪
caption:
BUSY MEN: YOUR PHYSIQUE IS BUILT BY WHAT YOU REPEAT. 💪

You don’t need a perfect diet, hours in the gym or an extreme routine to start changing your body.

You need consistent habits that fit your lifestyle.

Here are 5 habits I’d focus on:

👟 1. WALK MORE
Build your daily steps. Start with a target you can maintain.

🏋️ 2. LIFT 3 TIMES A WEEK
Build strength, muscle and a physique that performs.

🥩 3. PRIORITISE PROTEIN & PORTIONS
Build filling meals, manage your calories and fuel your training.

😴 4. PROTECT YOUR SLEEP
Better recovery, energy and consistency start with a good sleep routine.
